decision: Record external operational knowledge as non-authoritative reference input to the existing FA3 Knowledge Fabric, define a canonical Knowledge-to-Runbook interface, and forbid any direct execution path from retrieved text or community source content.

interface_boundary.ingress: External sources enter only as provenance-bound KnowledgeSource records and have no execution authority.
interface_boundary.retrieval: PageIndex/OpenKB/ConDB-style providers may derive and retrieve context but may not convert source text into executable authority.
interface_boundary.verification: Community-derived operational knowledge requires provenance, immutable revision or digest, freshness assessment, and target compatibility assessment before VERIFIED knowledge state.
interface_boundary.runbook_projection: Actionable operational guidance must be normalized into a typed RunbookObject with intent, risk class, required capabilities, implementation candidates, evidence references, and execution policy.
interface_boundary.execution: RunbookObject never executes itself. Any action must resolve to an admitted typed FA3 capability and cross FA3-AUTH-MCP-GATEWAY-001 with security policy, approval, HRB and sandbox controls as applicable.
interface_boundary.secrets: Knowledge and Runbook objects may carry opaque secret references only; inline credentials and secret material are forbidden.

hardware_audit_compliance.rule: Knowledge and Runbook records describe capabilities and compatibility requirements; they must not encode a global NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, CUDA, ROCm, GPU SKU, CPU SKU, desktop or compositor requirement.

constraints: Do not create a FA3-PROVIDER-TRIMSTRAY-001 provider.
Do not create a parallel Knowledge canonical root.
Do not let PageIndex, OpenKB, ConDB, a model, an agent, the GUI, or a source adapter directly execute retrieved commands.
Do not treat age, popularity, stars, or community curation as verification.
Do not promote community content to VERIFIED without provenance, freshness and compatibility checks.
Do not expand the canonical capability count.
